title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (d/m/w)
description:
Job Description:

Unternehmen: Airbus Defence and Space

Standort: Tesat, Backnang

Vertragsart: Vollzeit

Um die Zukunft autonomer Systeme zu gestalten, bündelt Airbus seine Kräfte in den Bereichen Künstliche Intelligenz und Autonomie. Zu diesem Zweck bauen wir am traditionsreichen Technologiestandort der Tesat in Backnang ein neues, agiles Kompetenz- und Entwicklungszentrum auf. In diesem Umfeld, das jahrzehntelange Expertise in der Weltraumtechnik mit der Dynamik eines Start-Ups verbindet, entwickeln wir die nächste Generation KI-gestützter Verteidigungs- und Dual-Use-Anwendungen.

Ihre Rolle

Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer (d/m/w) bringen Sie KI-Algorithmen von der Forschung in die Produktion. Sie erarbeiten Konzepte, entwickeln und adaptieren state-of-the-art Architekturen und helfen dabei, die versprochene Performance im Feld sicherzustellen.

Ihre Vorteile

Die einmalige Gelegenheit, die Zukunft autonomer Systeme bei einem weltweit führenden Luft- und Raumfahrtunternehmen zu gestalten
Ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld, das die Innovationskraft eines Start-Ups mit der Expertise und Sicherheit eines etablierten Konzerns verbindet
Ein Team von brillanten Köpfen, die gemeinsam an einer großen Vision für Europas technologische Souveränität arbeiten
Ein moderner Tech-Stack zur vollen Entfaltung (Kubernetes, Kubeflow, MLFlow, GitLab, Linux, …) sowie mehrere Entwicklungsumgebungen (skalierbare Cloud, eigene on-prem-Lösung).
Ein attraktives Gehalt, flexible Arbeitszeiten und exzellente Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung innerhalb des Airbus-Konzerns
Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (bis zu 40% mobiles Arbeiten)

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie sorgen dafür, dass aus ML-Modellen einsatzfähige Bausteine für autonome UAVs werden, über alle Domänen hinweg, von der Perception bis zur Entscheidungsfindung. Dabei können folgende Aufgaben in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich liegen.

Modellentwicklung: Entwurf, Implementierung und Training modernster ML-Modelle, in den Bereichen Computer Vision, Sensorfusion oder Reinforcement Learning
Produktive Systeme: Benchmarking und Monitoring von Modellen in Produktivsystemen und Schließen der Feedbackschleife.
MLOps: Gezielter Umgang mit hoch-skalierbaren Systemen für umfangreiche Trainings mit reproduzierbaren Ergebnissen.
Kontinuierliche Fortbildung: Beobachten der neuesten Entwicklungen im Bereich autonome KI.
Verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit sicherheitsriskanten Themen, insbesondere hinsichtlich Exportkontrolle.
Kollaboration mit anderen Teams: Abstimmung über die Einbettung der Algorithmen in Simulationsumgebungen und Software-Stacks.

Ihr Profil

Mindestanforderungen:

Abgeschlossenes Studium im MINT-Bereich , z.B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Elektrotechnik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder Künstliche Intelligenz
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Machine Learning/ AI Engineer, Data Scientist oder Research Engineer
Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse und Freude an sauberer, wartbarer Software.
Tiefgehendes Wissen von Deep Learning Architekturen und deren Adaption für den jeweiligen Use Case
Erfahrung darin, wie man produktive KI-Algorithmen nach CI/CD und MLOps best-practices trainiert und bereitstellt
Systemdenken : Sie denken in Gesamtlösungen statt in Einzelteilen und behalten auch dann den Überblick, wenn Modelle aus vielen Quellen zusammenkommen.
Teamgeist und Gestaltungslust : Sie kommunizieren klar und haben Lust, einen Hub mitzugestalten, der noch im Entstehen ist.
Verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch

Vorteilhaft:

Ein Schwerpunkt auf Computer Vision und/ oder Reinforcement Learning
Erfahrung in der Luftfahrt und/ oder Verteidigungsbranche
Bisherige Arbeit mit verschiedenen Sensormodalitäten (Radar, LiDAR) sowie umfangreicher Sensorfusion
Codingerfahrung in C++
Kenntnisse in Modelloptimierung für Edge-Inferenz

Wir suchen Talente auf verschiedenen Karrierestufen. Die konkrete Eingruppierung erfolgt basierend auf Ihrer individuellen Erfahrung.

Keine 100%ige Übereinstimmung? Kein Problem! Airbus unterstützt Ihr persönliches Wachstum mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungslösungen. Wir stellen nach Potenzial und Erfahrung ein.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Turn product data into decisions that improve customer value and product performance. By defining the metrics that matter and connecting product, customer, and commercial signals, you help uncover where the biggest opportunities and challenges are and turn evidence into action.

The Cloud Product Organization brings together the capabilities needed to build and grow our cloud products. With clear responsibilities and close connections across the wider TFS portfolio, we work together to create customer value.

About The Job

You build the evidence base for a growth-focused product organization, defining the metrics that matter and making product performance easy to understand. Your analysis supports discovery, prioritization, and decisions across the product portfolio, while helping identify how data can create direct commercial value for customers in and around the products they use. You report to the Head of Cloud Product.

Job Responsibilities



- Own product analytics and define, track and develop the metrics that matter. 
- Analyze product usage and user behavior, translating findings into concrete recommendations. 
- Support product discovery and prioritization with evidence and actionable insights. 
- Develop and maintain dashboards, analyses, and recurring insights that make product performance easy to understand. 
- Combine product usage, customer and commercial signals to identify opportunities, risks, and trends. 
- Turn gathered data into customer-facing insights and opportunities that create commercial value in and around our products, while improving adoption and product performance. 

Location & flexibility 

This position offers flexibility to work remotely or from one of our entities in Sweden, Germany, the US, or India.

Your profile 

You bring a analytical background and know how to move from complex data to conclusions that non-technical stakeholders can use. Experience in data analytics, product analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical field gives you the foundation to understand product behavior and turn it into practical recommendations.

Your background includes:



- Hands-on experience analyzing product usage and user behavior, including defining and working with KPIs, product metrics and measurement frameworks. 
- Strong analytical skills and experience working with large or complex datasets. 
- Experience with analytical and visualization tools such as Power BI. 
- The ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to Product Managers, commercial teams and leadership. 
- Preferably, experience in digital, SaaS or cloud products and working knowledge of SQL or similar data-querying approaches. 

Experience in a product-led or growth-focused organization is an advantage. It’s also beneficial if you understand SaaS/product metrics, or have supported product discovery, prioritization and experimentation with data.

Curiosity shapes how you work. You investigate why customers behave as they do, while keeping the focus on what the evidence means for customers, the product and the business. Collaborative yet independent, you communicate complex findings clearly, work pragmatically and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions constructively when the data points in a different direction.

The team 

You work closely with Product Managers and the Head of Cloud Product, as well as Data Services, which provides the underlying data layer. Customer Success and Sales are also important partners, bringing customer and revenue signals that help build a more complete picture of product performance.

Our culture 

Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results.  Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? The Optics and Sensing Laboratory at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems in Tübingen has an open position for a Research Engineer (f/m/d) to join the ongoing research efforts in the development of statistical 3D models of Quadrupeds.

About Us

We are creating the world’s most realistic human and animal avatars for use in research, film, virtual reality, biology and medicine. Using unique 3D & 4D capture facilities, machine learning, computer vision and advanced graphics, we are modeling every nuance of how humans and animals look and move. We develop algorithms to estimate human shape and motion in images, videos, RGB-D sequences, etc. Our approaches define the current state of the art, and we are constantly pushing these methods and systems to achieve better accuracy and greater usability.

Department Website

The project

Horses are one of the most beloved animals. They are beautiful in shape and motion; they have been used for carrying people and goods, for helping in farming, for racing, and also for therapy. We are interested in capturing horse motion from motion capture data to build marker-less motion capture systems for horses. We are collaborating with the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and IMATI-CNR in developing a system for the markerless motion capture of horses. Our approach is based on creating a highly realistic 3D articulated model of horses from data. To this goal, we need to capture partial 3D scans of real animals and register them to a predefined horse template. Doing this enables us to model the shape of real horses and the shape variability across a range of individuals with different characteristics. In this research context, we are looking for a talented research engineer to pursue the project.

Roles and responsibilities



- 

- Investigation, implementation and evaluation of potential model improvements, for example: skeleton/joint paradigms, shape space encoding variations, pose-dependent deformations, etc.
- Conceptualization and development of model evaluation procedures, including quantitative and qualitative metrics.
- Development of various Minimum-Viable-Product pipelines, including image/video mesh recovery models and use-case applications (e.g. body conformation scoring from model outputs).
- Enhancement of the process for re-training and establishing a continuous learning pipeline.
- Improvement of an established robust method for registering 3D parametric model templates to cleaned 3D scans.
- Project management: definition and evaluation of project steps and directions.
Education and experience



- Experience with 3D parametric body models (i.e., SMPL/MANO/ATLAS/VAREN/etc.)
- Experience in Computational Geometry, Computer Vision and Deep Learning
- Accepted publications in one of these fields are a big advantage
- Good programming skills in Python or C++; PyTorch (or similar) experience
- Project management experience and the ability to work independently in dynamic environments
- Experience in one or more of the following: Point-cloud libraries, OpenCV, 3D rendering pipelines and deep-learning frameworks
- Good oral and written communication skills in English
- Enjoyment of collaborative work and multidisciplinary projects
- A minimum of a Master’s degree is required
- Experience writing production-level code is a plus

Our offer

In this working environment, you will be exposed to cutting-edge technologies related to computer vision and multi-sensor systems. The MPI for Intelligent Systems is one of the world's leading research institutions for machine learning, computer vision and robotics, and for studying the concepts of intelligence and autonomous behavior in artificial systems at different length scales. The position is ideally suited for candidates looking to extend their scientific and cultural horizons, particularly in the area of 3D Motion Capture. You will be a part of a dynamic team of international scientists, engineers, and administrative staff.

The Max Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals. The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society seeks to increase the number of women in its workforce in those areas where they are underrepresented and therefore explicitly encourages women to apply.

The position is available now and is limited to 1 year, with the possibility of extension; the expected start date is as soon as possible.

Als IT-Beratung und Entwicklungspartner gestalten wir seit 1969 kundenorientierte IT-Lösungen, unabhängig von Kapitalmarkt und Herstellern.
